snippet.title: Cairn – Reveal Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Cairn climbs onto Nintendo Switch 2 in early 2027! Play the free demo today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cairn-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

As pro climber Aava, set out to conquer the legendary Mount Kami. Experience the challenge and exhilaration of climbing as you scale the vertiginous cliffs. Plan your route carefully, managing resources during the expedition. The whole mountain is yours to explore, filled with unexpected encounters and long-lost mysteries. Get ready to push beyond your limits in a quest for absolute freedom!

#NintendoDirect #Cairn

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
